CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.G.S. KAMAL  ORAL ORDER Petitioners are before this Court seeking following reliefs;
"a). Direct the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 to release the compensation insofar as the petitioners are concerned as calculated by the fifth respondent as per letter dated 08.10.2020 bearing No.BMRCL/BhuSwa/Hanta- 2/ NG-R6-UG-P64A/2017-18/303 vide Annexure-F.
b) Issue appropriate writ or directions as deemed fit by this Hon'ble Court in the facts and circumstances of the case".
2. Counsel for the petitioners submits that a corrigendum has been issued by the respondent -KIADB in the individual names of the parties, in that view of the matter the petitioners are entitled to seek release of the amount independently, notwithstanding the pendency of the dispute between parties in O.S.No.6574/2022 which in any case arose subsequent to issuance of the corrigendum.

He further submits present petition is necessitated in view of the apprehension of NC: 2025:KHC:930 the petitioners that the compensation payable to the petitioners as per Annexure-F is determined under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act and in view of the pending disputes, the respondents- KIADB may revert back to the general award causing hardship to the petitioners.
Hence, the urgency.

3. In response, learned counsel for the respondent- KIADB submits that as per Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act the compensation can be paid only if there was no dispute or that any such dispute has been amicably resolved between the parties.

He further submits that if the contesting parties have consented for deposit of compensation amount as per the package sent by the respondent No.5-BMRCL vide Annexure-F, the respondent-KIADB will not be able to pay the compensation under Section 29(2) of the Act.
He however fairly submits that if a joint representation is made by the parties notwithstanding the pendency of the dispute in O.S.No.6574/2022, the same would be considered in accordance with law.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners at this juncture submits that in view of the pendency of suit in O.S.No.6574/2022 between the petitioners as well as the NC: 2025:KHC:930 private respondents,
necessary direction be issued to the respondent -KIADB to disburse the amount determined as per Annexure-F on conclusion of/ determination of their right in the said suit.
He also submits that the petitioners would endeavour to give such representation to the respondent -KIADB which may also be considered by them.
5. Submission is taken on record.
